credits.title: Banyak Anak Banyak Rejeki yang Harus Dicari
credits.overview: Gravedigger Babe Rojali lives in poverty with his wife Siti Juleha and their three children. During a heavy rain, as he was busy bailing out water from his leaky house, a neighborhood watchman arrived and asked him to dig a grave that night, at the request of the neighborhood head.
